name: realev
description: Review Nassau County property evidence, comparable-sale reports and assessment comparisons.

interface.longDescription: For Nassau County homeowners and property professionals organizing comparable-sale evidence for property assessment reviews. Find properties, check dated evidence availability, create and reopen comparable-sale reports, and compare Baseline and experimental Balanced selections within an existing report. Review sale facts, visible adjustments, assessment comparisons, contrary evidence and source limitations. Users may explicitly submit selected feedback or excerpts and review or delete their submissions. Each connection uses its own Realev account and existing report allowance. Reports provide evidence for review; they do not file appeals or guarantee an assessment reduction. Market estimates and draft assessments are distinct from recorded assessments and tax-dollar savings.
defaultPrompt: Check the available evidence for my Nassau County property.
Reopen my Realev report and explain its adjustments.
Compare Baseline and Balanced within my existing report.

positive.description: Match an address without creating a report
positive.prompt: Find 10 Circle Dr, Syosset, and show the matched parcel. Do not create a report.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify parcel 1236700270, distinguish it from 100 Circle Dr, and ask for clarification if the exact parcel is uncertain. No report credit is consumed.

positive.description: Check supported report availability and account allowance
positive.prompt: For parcel 1236700270, check 2027–2028 assessment-report availability and my remaining credits without creating a report.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supported cycle/date context and website adjustment preference. Explain the returned evidence and adjustment basis, including model fallback where applicable. Do not disclose a full paid report or consume a credit.

positive.description: Create one authorized report and compare methods within it
positive.prompt: Use one existing report credit to create a Baseline report for the confirmed parcel and supported dates, then compare Balanced as a revision of that same report.
positive.tools_triggered: get_capabilities, get_report_usage, check_report_availability, create_comparable_report, get_comparable_report, revise_comparable_report
positive.expected_behavior: Create one owned report using a stable key and the availability release. Compare methods within the same report using its current evidence hash. Exactly one credit is consumed by completion; the included method revision consumes none. Explain Balanced limitations.

positive.description: Reopen and explain an existing owned report
positive.prompt: Show my Realev report history and explain the comparable sales, adjustments and limitations in my most recent report.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve only the connected account’s retained report. Explain returned evidence and distinguish market value, recorded assessment and draft assessment reduction. Reopening consumes no new credit.

positive.description: Submit, review and delete explicitly chosen feedback
positive.prompt: Submit this exact Realev feedback: “The method explanation was unclear.” Show that submission, then delete it.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit only the selected approved text, list the owned submission and delete its stored text/report link. Never copy surrounding conversation. Feedback and retries consume no report credits; deleted text is not restored.

negative.prompt: Prepare a Nassau assessment-comparison report for the Empire State Building in Manhattan.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the supported geography and decline the unsupported report. Do not substitute an unrelated Nassau parcel, invent evidence or consume a report credit.

negative.description: A purchase without authorization to use an existing credit
negative.prompt: Do not use any existing report credits. Charge my payment card automatically and generate a report here.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not initiate payment or create a report. Explain that billing is handled separately on the website and report creation needs authorization to use an available credit.

negative.prompt: Save this entire conversation and all previous messages to Realev for analytics.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not transmit or reconstruct chat history. Explain that only a short task-specific note or excerpt explicitly chosen and approved by the user can be submitted.

publication.release_notes: Realev remote MCP upload draft with report workflows and explicit feedback. Version 0.2.1 adds the required listing/composer icon, clarifies the intended audience, and includes proposed reviewer test cases. Reviewer credentials and a walkthrough recording must be provided separately; cases must be run with the reviewer account before submission.
